**标签**: `#supply chain security`, `#AI coding tools`, `#VS Code extensions`, `#marketplace security`, `#SSH backdoor` --- ### [Northflank 被指遭入侵，现有材料缺细节](https://status.northflank.com/) ⭐️ 7.0/10 一篇 Hacker News 帖子以“Northflank Breached”为题，链接到 Northflank 状态页，指称这家云平台遭到入侵；但所给材料没有状态页正文或 Northflank 官方说明，泄露范围、受影响服务和事件时间线均无法核实。对使用 Northflank 的团队而言，客户代码、环境变量或数据是否受影响也尚不明确。 hackernews · js4ever · 10月30日 15:10 · [社区讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50305025) **「背景：Northflank 与此次安全事件」** Northflank 是一个面向开发者的云部署平台，提供多租户的容器与数据库托管服务。其状态页在 2026 年 10 月 30 日将事件标记为“Security incident”（安全事件），级别为已确认的重大故障，起始时间约为当天 6:40 AM GMT-7，此后持续发布更新。有 Hacker News 评论者称，自 9 月以来已有多家多租户即服务厂商遭遇类似攻击，但这属于社区说法，尚未得到该状态页或本条目内容的确认。 **「社区讨论」** jonathaneunice 声称自 9 月以来至少有六起针对多租户 as-a-service 厂商的快速攻击，并把 Northflank 与 PingCAP/TiDB、Fireworks AI、Zeabur、OpenCode Console、Railway 并列，称这是一场信息安全紧急事件。dangoodmanUT 则认为这类事件可能促使企业客户回流超大规模云厂商，并称自己通过加密环境变量、把解密密钥硬编码在代码中，使平台被攻破时仍需拿到客户二进制才能解密。

top5.title_en: Alibaba and Apple Partner to Integrate Qwen into Apple Intelligence, Beta Testing Opens Nov 4
top5.summary_en: On October 31, Alibaba announced a partnership with Apple to integrate Qwen into Apple Intelligence, letting Chinese users access Qwen's text and image understanding and content generation in Siri, writing tools and visual intelligence. Testing opens November 4 with the iOS developer beta, launching with iOS 27.3 in December; users opt in, and requests and responses are not used for model training.

top5.title: Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
top5.summary: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from past sessions to cut coding agent token costs by 18.4% to 30.9% on SWE-Bench, with no change to the agent. The post Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9% appeared first on MarkTechPost .
